releases.title: A faster, clearer Events screen for photographers

items.title: Tabs that fit your work
items.body: Your events, bookings and opportunities now sit in four equal tabs along the top, so you can reach each one with a single tap.

items.title: Filter by status
items.body: Narrow the list to upcoming, live or ended events, or to the ones waiting for your answer, and see a helpful message when nothing matches.

items.title: An optional calendar
items.body: Switch to a month, week or agenda view when you want to plan by date. Pick a day to filter the list, and remove the date with one tap.

items.title: Quick actions on press and hold
items.body: Each event row is more compact. Press and hold it for stream, album, QR code and remove, while Accept and Deny stay on pending requests.

releases.title: Share your albums with a link or QR code

items.title: Link and QR for Find My Photos
items.body: When an album is live on Find My Photos, open it and tap Share to get a QR code and a link. Attendees scan or open it, take a selfie and find their photos.

items.title: Paid albums go live on their own
items.body: A paid personal album is now published to Find My Photos as soon as its photos are uploaded, with the price you set, and the share sheet opens right away.

items.title: Set a price before publishing an event album
items.body: The first time you publish an event album, you choose the price per photo and its currency, the same as on the web dashboard.

items.title: The Connekyt logo in every QR code
items.body: Every QR code in the app, and the ones you save, now carries the Connekyt logo in the middle and still scans.

releases.title: A clearer event page, and wishes you can invite others to send

items.title: Wishes and memories in one card
items.body: Send your own wish, or switch to Invite loved ones to share a QR code and a link. Anyone who opens it sees the event and can send a wish without an account.

items.title: Date and time together
items.body: The date, the time with its timezone and an Add to calendar button now sit in one card.

items.title: One Hosted by card
items.body: When the organizer is also the photographer you see one row with both roles. The photographer opens their profile.

items.title: Choose who can invite others to send wishes
items.body: Every event now has a Wish invites setting. Enable it and viewers can share a link or QR so loved ones send their wishes too, or disable it to keep wishes to your own viewers. You can change it at any time, even while live.

releases.title: Events show the right state, and hosts can unpublish

items.title: Events sit in the right tab
items.body: An event that has already ended no longer shows under Soon or Upcoming. Explore, your stories, the badges and My hosted events now agree on whether an event is upcoming, live or ended.

items.title: Unpublish and republish
items.body: Hosts can hide an event, upcoming or ended, from Explore from the menu on its card, and republish it later. Unpublished events stay visible to you with an Unpublished badge.

items.title: Clearer Go live buttons
items.body: Go live and My hosted events on Home now look like buttons, and hosted event cards show the date, a status badge and a red Go live button.

releases.title: A new live event page, with wishes

items.title: Wishes & Memories
items.body: Viewers can send a video wish of up to a minute or a short message, and choose whether it is public or private before sending. Public wishes appear in the event feed once the host approves them.

items.title: Invite with a link or QR
items.body: Hosts and guests can share an event link or save its QR code as a picture, so friends can send wishes too.

items.title: A clearer live page
items.body: The live page now shows the event name, host and location under the video, with Live and Wishes & Memories tabs. Hosts see the same layout on the Go live page, with their wishes waiting for approval.
